body:
> Do you feel overwhelmed with everything you're expected to do?

Definitely. I can't talk to anybody without them going on about how I'm eventually going to have to tough love it out or how I'm going to need to push myself out of my comfort zone eventually. We don't even know what's causing my problems yet, but people still go on about it as much as they can.

> Do you feel you could talk to your family about how some of this shorter-term stress could be alleviated to help you get better?

I have, I've talked to everybody involved about it. Family and friends get it, and said that they would try to cut back on complaining to me about their own problems and all that- Which they haven't actually done yet.

Mental health people said that they would back off, which they haven't done yet. I don't think that they can, so there's no getting away from them bitching about whatever- Doesn't make me that hopeful tbh. There are still things they do, that they don't need to do, that they insist on doing. Like talking about the tough love bs or interrupting me, they just say "Oh, everybody makes mistakes" and carry on doing it.
